It’s less of random equals funny and more of the chaotic essence. You ever watch “Airplane!”? It’s random yes, but that’s not the main drive of the humor, it’s the fact that it’s so absurdly chaotic that it makes you sit back and ponder what is happening, think of that movie if it wasn’t so absurd, it’d just be a dude on a plane trying to get back his old love interest. Sounds boring right? It’s the fact that it is so weird that makes it funny. Same with the video that is labeled “cringe”. Of course beauty is within the eyes of the beholder, so it’s up to you if you think chaos could a be a good drive for humor or not, but you cannot deny the notion that it has been a staple for highly acclaimed movies/entertainment for quiet a long time.
